name: Gadrock
research_notes: Day pass listed as $15 (no adult/child split). Shoes listed in the gear rental package (shoes, harness, chalk $5). FAQ: yoga classes and a multi-purpose room with limited fitness equipment.

name: Arkose - La Rochelle
research_notes: Arkose La Rochelle page (URL xp-larochelle) is inside the Impact Stadium complex; address matches. Training = "espace entraînement en mezzanine".

name: Newcastle Climbing Centre
day_pass: £15 adult day pass (all climbing), £9 boulder only
research_notes: St Marks Church, Shields Road: roped walls, bouldering zone and auto belays. Pricing page: Day Pass £15 (all climbing), Boulder Only £9, member adult £13.50. Pin (54.9783,-1.6178) is about 2.7 km west of the official address (postcodes.io NE6 2UQ = 54.9787,-1.5754). Separate gym from seed-923 Eden Rock Newcastle.

name: Mono Loco
research_notes: Hours set null because pages disagree: /pages/oppettider and the homepage text give Mon-Thu 12-20, Fri 11-19, Sat-Sun 10-16 (ordinary hours from 31 Aug), but the footer on every page says Mon-Thu 13-21, Fri 13-19, Sat-Sun 10-16. Summer hours also published. Kids from family climbing / kids courses on homepage; parking: free parking in front of Främby hallar; shoe rental 45 kr.

name: Steamboat Climbing Collective
research_notes: Hours left null: seasonal (Fall-Winter vs Summer May-Aug differ) and the Fall-Winter line reads 'Fri 10:30p-8p' (typo), 'Sat Closed'. Training = Kilter board, campus board; kids climbing area with slide; shoe rental $3. Nominatim puts Jacob Circle at 40.5067,-106.8590, about 3.3 km northwest of our pin (40.485,-106.8317), same town.

name: Central Rock Gym – Hadley
research_notes: curl is blocked by Cloudflare (403); page read via WebFetch (returned structured text). Day pass price not shown on the location page (/day-pass pages 404 or show no price), so null. Facilities: fitness area, yoga studio, youth programs/camps. Hours list per day Mon 7-10, Tue 11-10, Wed 7-10, Thu 11-10, Fri 7-10, Sat/Sun 10-7.

name: Climb Warrior - Granada
research_notes: Hours (contact page 'Donde estamos'): Mon-Thu 10-13:30 & 17-21:30, Fri 10-13:30 & 17-21, Sat 10-14; Sunday not stated so sun omitted (not inferred as Closed). Day pass: 'Entrada libre Rocodromo 6 EUR' (OCR 8, combined 10). Facilities: cafe/bar and strength/aerobic zone on home page; kids = birthday/school group activities page; shoe-hire: tarifas page says cat's feet of all sizes 'disponibles en recepcion' (rental implied, price not stated). Hybrid gym/OCR/climbing centre with a 100 m2 bouldering area.

name: MOVE Climbing - Sevilla Hytasa
research_notes: Hours: site only links 'Horario Hytasa' to a Google Maps listing, no hours text, so null. Day pass per tarifas table (Hytasa column): Normal 12, Reducido 10, Matinal 8. Facilities from Hytasa page banner: CUERDA, BOULDER, ENTRENAMIENTO, FAMILY ZONE, RESTAURANTE, TIENDA (restaurant mapped to cafe). New centre (2026).

name: Tokyo Wall - Granada
research_notes: Hours set to null: /horarios/ gives free-climb access Tue/Thu/Sat 10:00-13:30 and Mon-Fri 17:00-22:30 with no Sunday, while /precios/ prices mornings as 10:00-14:00 and weekends/holidays 'cualquier horario', so pages disagree and Sunday is not stated. Day pass per /precios/: morning 6, afternoon 8, weekend and holidays 8 (not labelled adult). Facilities: yoga room, strength training room, shoe rental 'pies de gato 2 EUR' (FAQ). Shop link goes to a separate store site (storetokyowall.es), not listed. Training centre (yoga, calisthenics) with a 250 m2 climbing area.

name: Klättercentret Uppsala
day_pass: 190 kr adult, 135 kr before 4pm weekdays, 152 kr student
research_notes: Hours: Mon-Thu 11-22, Fri 9-22, weekends 10-20. Rental shoes 50 kr. A "Café & Butik" menu item exists but only the shop page has explicit text, so cafe not listed.

name: Elevation Rock Gym
research_notes: Visit page: Mon-Fri 6am-10pm, Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 10am-6pm; $19 day pass (12+), $7 extra for rentals. Home page lists yoga, youth camps and afterschool programs. Pin town matches.

name: GRAVITY RESEARCH Himeji
research_notes: Hours left null: page says weekdays 13:00-22:00, Sat/Sun/holidays 10:00-21:00 but also 'closed Tuesdays, per the business calendar', so Tuesday is unclear. Prices are adult 120-min and free-time (first registration 1,200 excluded; happy hour/night rates exist). Rental shoes 400. Parking is paid, so not listed.

name: Kray Sveta
research_notes: Hours: weekdays 8:15-22:30, weekends 9:00-22:00 (home, contacts and service pages agree). Day pass per /price: 750 RUB weekdays 8:15-16:00 and weekends after 18:00, 1200 RUB weekdays after 16:00 and weekends 9-18; but /uslugi/free shows 700/1000 RUB, so the exact price is uncertain (used the dedicated price page). Facilities: rental shoes/harness, children's room and kids climbing zone/school. Nominatim: Tveritina 45 = our pin.

name: Calgary Climbing Centre SoCal Bouldering
research_notes: Location page is titled "South Calgary Bouldering" (site menu: "SoCal Bouldering"). Hours "Mon - Fri: 6am -11pm; Sat - Sun: 8am - 10pm". Day pass from chain-wide rates page (excl. GST). Facilities from location page: cafe, training area (campus board, weights), Approach retail shop, "Tons of parking".

name: Blue Granite Climbing Gym
research_notes: Hours everyday 10am-10pm; members-only hours 7am-10am excluded. Day pass includes yoga/fitness classes and cardio/free weight equipment; gear rental package (shoes, harness, chalk bag) listed.
